arabic text: MOLA ZAHOOR KIJIE HAR DIL KI HAI SADA\nARMAAN HAI SAATH AAPKE HUM JAAEIN KARBALA
english translation text: Maula, reappear—this is every heart's cry.\nWe long to travel to Karbala with you.

arabic text:
MANZAR HAI KARBALA KA NIGAAHON ME AAPKI
HO AAP NOHA KHWAN WAHAAN HUM HO MATAMI
HAI AAPKO HUSSAIN KI GHURBAT KA WASTA
ARMAAN HAI SAATH AAPKE HUM JAAEIN KARBALA
english translation text:
The scenes of Karbala remain before your eyes.
May you recite the lament there, while we perform matam.
By Hussain's loneliness, we plead:
we long to travel to Karbala with you.

arabic text:
FARSHE AZA PE BAITH KE SUN-NA HAI AAPSE
KAISE HUSSAIN ZEEN SE AAYE ZAMEEN
MAWJOOD HAI MAQAAM WAHI AB BHI AAPKA
ARMAAN HAI SAATH AAPKE HUM JAAEIN KARBALA
english translation text:
Seated upon the mourning floor, we wish to hear from you
how Hussain came from the saddle to the ground.
That very place of yours still remains there.
We long to travel to Karbala with you.

arabic text:
THAAME HUWE HUSSAIN KE KURTE KO HAATH ME
HOTI HAIN HAR MAQAAM PE ZAHRA BHI SAATH ME
DENA HAI PURSA FATEMA ZAHRA KO SHAH KA
ARMAAN HAI SAATH AAPKE HUM JAAEIN KARBALA
english translation text:
Holding Hussain's shirt within her hands,
Zahra accompanies you at every place.
We wish to offer Shabbir's condolences to Fatima Zahra.
We long to travel to Karbala with you.

arabic text: AKBAR SE NAWJAWAAN NE KHAAYI JAHAAN SINA\nKHAYA THA TEER ASGHAR E BESHEER NE JAHAAN\nHAI AARZOO KE DEKHE LE HUM JAAKE WOH JAGAA
english translation text: Where the young Akbar was struck by the spear,\nand where the speechless Asghar received the arrow—\nwe long to go and behold those places.

arabic text:
JAB DONO HAATH KAT CHUKE PAANI KE WAASTE
KISTARHA AAYE KHAAK PER ABBAS ZEEN SE
GHAZI KA HAAL SOCH KE ROTA HAI DIL MERA
ARMAAN HAI SAATH AAPKE HUM JAAEIN KARBALA
english translation text:
After both arms were severed while seeking water,
how did Abbas fall from the saddle onto the dust?
My heart weeps when thinking of Ghazi's condition.
We long to travel to Karbala with you.

arabic text: AY MOLA AA BHI JAAYE ATA NAHI HAI CHAIN\nYAAD AA RAHA HAI HUMKO BOHOT ROZA E HUSSAIN\nZEESHAN AUR KARIM YE KARTE HAI ILTEJA
english translation text: O Maula, come now; we find no peace.\nWe deeply miss Hussain's shrine.\nZeeshan and Karim make this plea.
